analysis.detail: Nesting depth constraint bypass in Jackson Core 3.x UTF8DataInputJsonParser and ReaderBasedJsonParser. maxNestingDepth from StreamReadConstraints is not enforced, allowing a deeply nested JSON document to cause StackOverflowError. Liquibase is a CLI tool that only parses JSON from trusted, operator-controlled configuration files and changelog artifacts. It does not expose any JSON parsing endpoint to remote or untrusted input. As established in the prior assessment of GHSA-2m67-wjpj-xhg9, Liquibase does not rely on StreamReadConstraints as a security boundary.

vulnerabilities.description: Jackson Core 3.x maxNestingDepth constraint bypass in multiple parser implementations, enabling DoS via StackOverflowError from deeply nested JSON input.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase does not parse untrusted JSON input.

ratings.justification: Liquibase only parses operator-controlled JSON files and does not rely on StreamReadConstraints for protection.

analysis.detail: Repo-wide searches found no source declaration for tools.jackson.core:jackson-core. The build only references com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core 2.22.1 at pom.xml:57,150-151, community-extensions/liquibase-mongodb/pom.xml:48,90-92, and core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:137. The scanner-reported 3.1.0 coordinate is not present in the codebase.

vulnerabilities.description: UTF8DataInputJsonParser._reportInvalidToken() in jackson-core builds the offending-token text for its error message by appending Java identifier characters to a StringBuilder in a loop that has no upper bound and never consults the configured maximum error-token length. A malformed token supplied to a parser created from a DataInput is therefore accumulated in full, which can exhaust the JVM heap.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. No shipped code parses JSON through Jackson's DataInput-backed parser. A future release moves the bundled copy to a fixed version.

ratings.justification: Nothing in the shipped jars hands a DataInput to Jackson, so the parser with the unbounded error buffer is never created.

analysis.detail: Fixed in tools.jackson.core jackson-core 3.1.7 and 3.2.3. Liquibase Secure 6.0.0 carries one Jackson 3 copy, 3.2.2, inside the Cassandra extension, where it is used by the bundled Cassandra driver. The license-tracking application in the 5.1.x and 5.2.x ZIP also carries Jackson 3 copies inside the advisory range. Earlier images carry no Jackson 3. The unbounded error-token buffer is in UTF8DataInputJsonParser, which Jackson creates only for input supplied as a java.io.DataInput. A bytecode scan of every class in every shipped jar, the Cassandra extension and the license-tracking application included, found no code outside Jackson itself that passes a DataInput to Jackson, so the parser with the unbounded buffer is never created.
